problem: Motion graphics take hours in tools like After Effects; Hera generates and edits them from text.
product_category: AI motion graphics and creative canvas

founders.name: Peter Tribelhorn
prior_employers: Lunar X (acquired and managed YouTube channels with 30M+ subscribers)
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM generated animation code on an editable canvas; mostly applied AI engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Prompt to animation is copyable; brand kits and community templates add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Adjacent AI video tools expanded; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: YC page reports 100k+ waitlist signups in 8 weeks and 50,000+ animations at launch (company claims); a WHU article calls it the most visited S25 startup.

branding.brand_signature: Product Hunt number one product of the day badge

brand_strength.rationale: Strong launch virality (Product Hunt, waitlist) per company and Product Hunt posts, though the name is shared with other firms.

outcome_analysis: Hera launched in May 2025 and claims fast waitlist and animation growth, then broadened from motion graphics to an AI creative canvas with API access. Funding is not publicly confirmed. No exit or failure news found. The crowded AI video space and large design incumbents are the main risks.
